flags.message: The provisioned petition is marked truncated, and its appendix specifically omits material from partway through page 49a through page 53a, cutting off the lower court's discussion of the production/enticement double-jeopardy claim. Prediction proceeds conservatively without reconstructing the missing pages; preserving the issue-relevant appellate opinion would improve the cell's inputs.
